task-scheduler.description: Plug scan scripts into Windows Task Scheduler for automatic triggering: - On login: quick scan - System idle (5 min): targeted scan of NWE directories - USB insert: targeted scan of removable media - Scheduled: daily full scan at 03:00

script.name: nwe-defender-quick.bat
script.content:
@echo off REM NitroWebExpress™ — Microsoft Defender Quick Scan REM Trigger: Windows Task Scheduler (on login) REM Author: Max Rupplin — MEARVK LLC
echo [%date% %time%] NWE Defender Quick Scan starting... >> "%~dp0\logs\defender-scan.log" "C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\MpCmdRun.exe" -Scan -ScanType 1 echo [%date% %time%] Quick Scan complete (exit=%ERRORLEVEL%) >> "%~dp0\logs\defender-scan.log"

script.name: nwe-defender-targeted.bat
script.content:
@echo off REM NitroWebExpress™ — Microsoft Defender Targeted Scan REM Trigger: Windows Task Scheduler (system idle 5 min) REM Scans NWE project directories for threats REM Author: Max Rupplin — MEARVK LLC
set NWE_ROOT=%~dp0\.. echo [%date% %time%] NWE Defender Targeted Scan starting... >> "%~dp0\logs\defender-scan.log"
REM Scan module user-files (uploaded content) "C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\MpCmdRun.exe" -Scan -ScanType 3 -File "%NWE_ROOT%\modules\chat\user-files" "C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\MpCmdRun.exe" -Scan -ScanType 3 -File "%NWE_ROOT%\modules\uncw\user-files"
REM Scan compiled output "C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\MpCmdRun.exe" -Scan -ScanType 3 -File "%NWE_ROOT%\out"
echo [%date% %time%] Targeted Scan complete (exit=%ERRORLEVEL%) >> "%~dp0\logs\defender-scan.log"

script.name: nwe-defender-full.bat
script.content:
@echo off REM NitroWebExpress™ — Microsoft Defender Full Scan REM Trigger: Windows Task Scheduler (daily at 03:00) REM Author: Max Rupplin — MEARVK LLC
echo [%date% %time%] NWE Defender Full Scan starting... >> "%~dp0\logs\defender-scan.log"
REM Update definitions first "C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\MpCmdRun.exe" -SignatureUpdate echo [%date% %time%] Definitions updated >> "%~dp0\logs\defender-scan.log"
REM Full system scan "C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\MpCmdRun.exe" -Scan -ScanType 2 echo [%date% %time%] Full Scan complete (exit=%ERRORLEVEL%) >> "%~dp0\logs\defender-scan.log"

script.name: nwe-defender-usb.bat
nwe-defender-update.bat
script.content:
@echo off REM NitroWebExpress™ — Microsoft Defender Signature Update REM Trigger: Windows Task Scheduler (system startup) REM Author: Max Rupplin — MEARVK LLC
echo [%date% %time%] Updating Defender definitions... >> "%~dp0\logs\defender-scan.log" "C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\MpCmdRun.exe" -SignatureUpdate echo [%date% %time%] Definitions updated (exit=%ERRORLEVEL%) >> "%~dp0\logs\defender-scan.log"

task-scheduler.task-import-note:
To register these scripts with Task Scheduler: schtasks /create /tn "NWE-Defender-Quick" /tr "C:\NWE\scripts
we-defender-quick.bat" /sc ONLOGON /rl HIGHEST schtasks /create /tn "NWE-Defender-Full" /tr "C:\NWE\scripts
we-defender-full.bat" /sc DAILY /st 03:00 /rl HIGHEST schtasks /create /tn "NWE-Defender-Update" /tr "C:\NWE\scripts
we-defender-update.bat" /sc ONSTART /rl HIGHEST schtasks /create /tn "NWE-Defender-Idle" /tr "C:\NWE\scripts
we-defender-targeted.bat" /sc ONIDLE /i 5 /rl HIGHEST

scripting-notes.note:
Microsoft Defender is the only free AV with a scriptable CLI (MpCmdRun.exe). Third-party free options (Bitdefender Free, Avast Free, AVG Free) intentionally lock down CLI from free tiers. MpCmdRun.exe can be called from: - PowerShell - Batch files (.bat) - Java ProcessBuilder - Python subprocess - Windows Task Scheduler (for event-based automation)
Automation triggers available via Task Scheduler: - ONLOGON: user logs in - ONIDLE: system idle for N minutes - ONSTART: system boot - DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY: time-based schedule - USB insert: requires custom WMI event subscription or Device Install trigger
ClamAV provides `clamscan` (on-demand) and `clamd` (daemon for real-time). `freshclam` updates virus definitions. Automation via cron or systemd timers.
